findings.summary: Self-employed users get no result for withdrawing before 6 years, so half of the reader's question goes unanswered.
With no fund figure showing, the lone 25,725 next to an empty dashed box could be mistaken for the answer, which could lead the reader to a wrong conclusion.
The input fields move around when switching to self-employed. This is a minor layout annoyance, and it shows the switch does change something.
The page scrolls slightly by itself when the year slider moves. This is a minor annoyance, and the reader doesn't tie it to the tax line or to crossing 6 years.
The bar labels are cut off and wrap onto several lines on a phone, which makes them hard to read. This is a display annoyance, not a blocker.
